messages:
Ava K: Quick heads-up — final signoff needed on observability roadmap items for next sprint: dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis panels, retention. Who's owning what? Any blockers? cc @Rajat P @Maya S
Rajat P: I can own tracing hooks (instrumentation + deploy). ETA end-of-week for staging hooks. Need confirmation of spans schema from Maya.
Maya S: I can finish the span schema today. Question: do we include baggage keys for request_id + user_segment for correlation? I lean yes.
Ben L: I'll own dashboard cards (errors + latency heatmap). Need an approved query for the slow-path card — is this the one?
Ben L: ```sql
SELECT p99_latency, route
FROM traces
WHERE service = 'console' AND env = 'staging'
```
Rajat P: That query is fine, use p95 for alerting. Also pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/128 — needs review.
Ava K: Marked. Ben, wire that query into alert-502 with a 10m eval window. @SRE-Bot can you run a smoke after the PR merge?
SRE-Bot: deploy-hook: canary rollout started for tracing-hooks:v2 in staging (3 nodes). See https://ci.redwood/build/7789 — will report status.
Maya S: Span schema PR: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/129 — added baggage keys and a changelog. Dependency: eng-runtime must expose `trace_id` header; pinged eng-runtime team. Without it sampling will be limited.
Rajat P: Eng-runtime change is small but could slip. Fallback plan: instrument to read `x-rw-trace` if present and map to span.trace_id in agent. That avoids blocking rollout.
Ben L: Retention question: ops recommends 30d for prod traces, 7d for staging. Any objections?
Maya S: +1. Also suggest compressing older traces to a minimal index after 7d to reduce storage (keep full payloads 30d).
Ava K: Consensus so far: tracing hooks -> Rajat, dashboards -> Ben, span schema -> Maya, retention policy -> Ben+Maya+Infra. Action: owners confirm PR URLs and expected merge dates by EOD today.
Rajat P: I will get one approval and merge. Target merge time: 2026-03-18T18:00Z.
Ben L: I'll open dashboard PR in ~2h and ping for quick review :thumbsup:.
Maya S: Filed dependency ticket for eng-runtime: https://issues.redwood/obs/542 — labeled blocking-traces.
Ava K: Thanks — if anything blocks, escalate in #eng-oncall. I'll capture this in the async update doc and follow up. :raised_hands:
